textSize.title: Text size
textSize.description: Base text size in pixels. Changes apply while the napplet is running.

controlSize.title: Control height
controlSize.description: Choose compact controls or larger touch targets, in pixels.

selectText.title: Allow text selection
selectText.description: Allow selecting interface text. Text inputs always remain selectable.

publisher.title: Trusted map publisher
publisher.description: Nostr public key in lowercase hex. Applies after restarting this napplet.

discoveryRelays.title: Discovery relay hints
discoveryRelays.description: Whitespace-separated WSS URLs. The shell owns routing and approval. Restart to apply.

preferredMaps.title: Preferred map IDs
preferredMaps.description: Optional whitespace-separated IDs. Empty follows the signed default view. Restart to apply.
